subject: Final signing runbook & custody transfer for MSA + Order Form
thread_body:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, contracts@acme-corp.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form: final signature logistics

Hi Elena / Acme contracts team,

Attached are the redlined MSA (v3) and the finalized Order Form. We'd like to finish execution this week. Proposed DocuSign plan below — please confirm signers and any delegation/POA we should expect:

- Routing: Elena Ruiz (VP Legal) -> Tom O'Neill (CFO) -> Acme accounting (contracts@acme-corp.com) as a final recipient (no signature).
- Authentication: email + optional access code for CFO.
- Sequential signing to preserve order and internal approval trace.
- Attachments: MSA_Acme_Redlines_v3.pdf; OrderForm_Acme_20280728.docx.

Please confirm:
1) Do we have authority confirmation for Tom to sign, or will we need a notarized POA?
2) Any additional witness requirements for Tom's jurisdiction?
3) Preferred window for signing (we can send the envelope tomorrow morning PST).

Once confirmed I'll prepare the envelope and include a short execution runbook and final clean copy delivery steps.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: MSA_Acme_Redlines_v3.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_Acme_20280728.docx (docx)

----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, contracts@acme-corp.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: final signature logistics

Aisha — thanks. Confirming signers below:
- Elena Ruiz (VP Legal) — will sign first.
- Tom O'Neill (CFO) — will sign second; Tom typically requires a POA for outside counsel or if signing is delegated. I will check with our corporate secretary and share any signed delegation.

We prefer sequential signing. If you can include a copy of the redline-accepted MSA as a PDF in the envelope (watermarked as "Executed Copy" after signing), that would be ideal.

Target: complete signatures by end of day Monday (7/31).

Elena
Elena Ruiz | VP Legal, Acme Corporation
attachments: none

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: final signature logistics

Elena — thanks for the quick reply.

We will:
- Include the redline-accepted MSA as a PDF in the envelope and mark it as the executed copy once the envelope completes.
- Attach the signed delegation (if Acme provides) into the envelope for the CFO step.
- Use sequential routing and include an "internal-only" notification to contracts@acme-corp.com (they will receive a copy but not required to sign).

Marcus — can ops prepare the envelope with these fields:
1) Signature block for Elena (email verified)
2) Signature block for Tom (email verified + access code = last 4 of company tax ID)
3) Checkbox for "Accept Order Form" next to signature

I'll prep the final clean copy once we have the delegation.

- Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
attachments: SignerDelegation_Acme_signed.pdf (pdf)

----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: final signature logistics

Agree sequential is safest. Quick ops questions:
- Do we want to enable signer telephone authentication for the CFO as an extra layer? Adds friction but reduces fraud risk.
- After envelope completion should we upload final signed PDF to S3 (contracts bucket) and trigger the HubSpot deal update?

If yes, I'll queue the ops ticket and set the post-sign webhooks.

Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

----
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Redwood Ops <contracts-ops@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Preparation: DocuSign envelope instructions (DO NOT SEND until confirmed)

Ops — please prepare but DO NOT SEND the envelope until I get confirmation from Acme on delegation. Attachments included for the envelope package and runbook. Steps:
1) Envelope name: "Redwood MSA & OrderForm - Acme Corp (ACME-2028-07-RID1234)"
2) Documents: MSA_Acme_Redlines_v3.pdf (primary), OrderForm_Acme_20280728.docx (secondary), SignerDelegation_Acme_signed.pdf (if provided).
3) Routing order (sequential): Elena Ruiz (elena.ruiz@acme-corp.com) -> Tom O'Neill (tom.oneill@acme-corp.com).
4) Authentication: Elena = email; Tom = email + access code (last 4 of tax ID). Optionally enable telephone auth if Acme confirms.
5) Fields: signature for each signer, date signed, checkbox "Accept Order Form" for CFO, initials block on page 3 for both signers.
6) Post-sign actions: auto-download completed PDF; upload to s3://redwood-contracts/acme/2028-07/; attach signed PDF to HubSpot deal; send copy to contracts@acme-corp.com and legal@redwood.ai.

Runbook (attached): Execution_Runbook_v1.2.md — includes steps for envelope build, authentication codes, webhook config, and clean-copy stamping ("Executed Copy - Redwood Inference / Acme Corporation").

I will forward Acme's delegation when Elena sends it.

Thanks,
Aisha
attachments: Execution_Runbook_v1.2.md (md)
